displayName: Watchlist monitor: no successful update for 12 hours

documentation.content:
The Cloud Run job **valuation-update** has not completed successfully for 12 hours, although it is scheduled every 4 hours. Either it fails every time (the other alert should have fired), or it is not starting at all: check that the Cloud Scheduler job **valuation-update-every-4h** is enabled and that its service account still has the Run Invoker role on the job.

See docs/operations.md in the repository.

conditions.displayName: No successful execution of valuation-update for 12 hours
